evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On an automotive multi-object detection benchmark and with a fixed budget of 200 synthetic training images, S-GDR reaches mAP50-95 = 0.739 on a real held-out test set, outperforming a domain-randomized render baseline (mAP50-95 = 0.697) as well as brightness filtering, perceptual hashing, CycleGAN style transfer, and unguided diffusion variants sharing the same 200-image budget.
